script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: It presents David's worry as a fact, though the text gives his prayer without stating that feeling.
Saying the people are throwing insults at David adds an intention the text does not state. David says their insults have fallen on him.
It says David does not mock them back. The psalm says he prays, but does not establish whether he mocked them back.
It makes David's relationship with his brothers the reason he is not counting on their prayers. The text does not give that reason.
It supplies David's existing trouble as the reason he is not asking for a test. The text gives no such reason.
Finding no comforters does not establish that nobody was there.
Saying God is the only one left for David to turn to goes beyond his statement that he found no comforters.
Saying David was just up to his neck in water treats the image as a past event and adds a change in his situation that the psalm does not state.
The verse says the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people. Saying He listens to His captive people merges the two statements.
The explanation that Zion is a name for Jerusalem is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
